title: Pilot: Modular On-Prem Licensing with Metered Upgrades and Optional Maintenance Windows
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: run a 6-week pilot offering a modular on-prem licensing option that separates base license fee, optional maintenance windows (scheduled upgrade packs), and pay-as-you-go critical-patch credits. The pilot will validate commercial appetite and operational impact for: 1) an explicit monthly license fee for core product runtime, 2) optional quarterly upgrade packs customers can opt into for low-risk scheduled upgrades, and 3) a small bundle of emergency patch credits billed on consumption for out-of-band hotfixes. Goals: 1) determine uplift in ARR from offering maintenance bundles, 2) quantify support and upgrade operational cost with 3 pilot customers, 3) capture any security questionnaire (SQQ)/contract friction points tied to entitlements and upgrade SLAs. Success metrics: signed pilot deals with 3 customers, average uplift per customer >= 12% ARR, <2 extra engineer-hours/week for upgrade orchestration during pilot, and legal/security checklist acceptance <= 2 rounds per customer. Out of scope: seat-based licensing experiments and deeply custom SOW negotiations (we will use a standardized pilot SOW).
